behaviors.find-email-normalizer: The new Email normalizer tool appears in the Development category and opens its own page.
behaviors.normalize-emails: Entering email addresses, one per line, updates a read-only output with a normalized result for each line.
behaviors.show-parse-error: An email address the tool cannot parse displays an “Unable to parse email” message for that line.
behaviors.copy-results: Copy normalized emails copies the displayed results and shows a confirmation toast.
behaviors.clear-emails: Clear emails empties both the input and the normalized output.
behaviors.disable-empty-copy: The copy button is disabled when there are no normalized results.

history.notes: The navigation locator scopes Email normalizer to the menu immediately after the Development heading. The example assumes the normalizer lowercases email domains; the disabled state is checked through the button’s CSS class, as implemented by c-button.
